title: Toyo Steel Toolbox T-320 Cantilever
description_en: Made in Japan since 1948, the Toyo Steel T-320 is the cantilever toolbox that inspired countless copies worldwide. Cold-rolled steel, powder-coated finish, spring-loaded latch. Used by Japanese carpenters for generations — and now a design icon.
description_ja: 1948年創業のTOYO STEELが作る日本の定番工具箱T-320。冷間圧延鋼とパウダーコーティングで錆に強く、バネ式ラッチで片手でも開閉可能。大工職人から世界中のデザインファンまでに愛される工具箱の原点。
